faqs.question: How do I convert a photo to black and white online?
faqs.answer: Upload your image, adjust the contrast and brightness sliders to your taste, and click Download B&W Image.

faqs.question: What formula is used for grayscale conversion?
faqs.answer: We apply the standard Rec.709 optical luminance formula: Y = 0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B, which accurately mimics human eye spectral sensitivity.

faqs.question: Can I adjust the contrast of the black and white image?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can adjust contrast from subtle soft grayscale to high-contrast dramatic monochrome.

faqs.question: Are my private photos uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. All pixel-level matrix conversions occur 100% locally in your web browser.

faqs.question: What image formats can I convert to black and white?
faqs.answer: You can upload JPG, PNG, WebP, and GIF images and export as crisp PNG or JPG.

faqs.question: Why does human perceived luminance (BT.601) look better than simple averaging (R+G+B)/3?
faqs.answer: Human eyes have peak sensitivity to green wavelengths and low sensitivity to blue. Weighting green at 58.7%, red at 29.9%, and blue at 11.4% mirrors real human vision, preventing blue skies from appearing unnaturally dark or foliage from becoming mud.

faqs.question: Are original color photos permanently modified?
faqs.answer: No. All processing operates on an in-memory duplicate canvas buffer. Your original photo remains untouched.

faqs.question: Can I re-export as PNG to keep transparency?
faqs.answer: Yes. The converter supports exporting in both JPG and transparent PNG formats.

faqs.question: Is my photograph uploaded to any cloud server?
faqs.answer: No. The pixel luminance calculation runs 100% inside your browser memory.

faqs.question: Welche Formel wird zur Grauwertberechnung genutzt?
faqs.answer: Die standardisierte Rec.709-Luminanzformel (Y = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B).

faqs.question: Kann man den Bildkontrast verstärken?
faqs.answer: Ja, über den integrierten Kontrastregler für ausdrucksstarke Monochrom-Effekte.

faqs.question: Werden Bilder auf einen Server geladen?

faqs.question: Welche Dateiformate werden unterstützt?

faqs.question: Warum ist die BT.601-Formel besser als der Durchschnitt (R+G+B)/3?
faqs.answer: Das menschliche Auge reagiert sensibler auf Grün als auf Blau. Die Gewichtung (58,7 % Grün, 29,9 % Rot, 11,4 % Blau) liefert natürliche Grauabstufungen.

faqs.question: Wird das Originalbild verändert?

faqs.question: Bleibt PNG-Transparenz erhalten?

faqs.question: Erfolgt ein Server-Upload?

faqs.question: Por que o padrão BT.601 é melhor que a média simples?
faqs.answer: A visão humana capta melhor o verde do que o azul. A proporção ponderada de 58,7% verde, 29,9% vermelho e 11,4% azul recria o brilho fotográfico real.
